summary: A regional lawmaker of the other party says the coming budget will tell more than the speech did.
realLife: In a regional roundup after a governor's yearly address, several opposition-party state lawmakers said they would judge the governor by the budget due a week later, one calling the speech hopeful talk and another saying it lacked specifics on prices, safety and schools.
sources: Mid-Hudson News (Hudson Valley, New York), 'Lawmakers react to Hochul's State of the State', January 10, 2024: https://midhudsonnews.com/2024/01/10/lawmakers-react-to-hochuls-state-of-the-state/
Read whole and coded paragraph by paragraph by a helper in this session (Nov 24, 2026); paraphrased, no sentence copied.
inGame: an official's stated reasons from the interview record and the executive budget record; needs: a stored reaction to an address

turns.name: praise first, details later
turns.pulledBy: the lawmaker agrees with one goal in the speech
turns.writes: the story pairs a kind word with a request for the budget's numbers

turns.name: flat dismissal
turns.pulledBy: the lawmaker's party is far from the governor's and the district has lost residents
turns.writes: the story quotes a short hard line and no offer to work together

turns.name: wait and say nothing
turns.pulledBy: the lawmaker declines to react before the budget arrives
turns.writes: the story says the lawmaker will comment on the budget instead
